title: 云依助手 0.12.13
releaseNotes: Reorganizes Network Debugger into full-width connection, receive-log and send sections. Keeps endpoints and connection actions in one row, and line ending, repeat interval and sending in another at standard window widths. Narrow windows wrap naturally. Removes the persistent local-processing notice while retaining risk and error feedback. Log growth stays inside its viewport and feedback does not obscure Send.
